occurrences.englishText: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
they also resorted to a ruse, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys, and old, torn-up and bound up wine skins,
to give prudence to the simple,
“I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling.
